chunks: Al-Bazanti narrated from al-Ridha عليه السلام, who said:
No one among my awliya' visits me, recognizing my right, except that I will intercede for him on the Day of Judgment.

key_terms.أَوْلِيَائِي: my devoted followers and loyal adherents
key_terms.عَارِفًا بِحَقِّي: recognizing my rightful status and due claim

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting Imam al-Ridha عليه السلام while recognizing his right?
ai.summary: This hadith states that visiting Imam al-Ridha عليه السلام with recognition of his right is a cause for his intercession on the Day of Judgment. It highlights both the spiritual rank of the Imam and the significance of ma'rifah of the Imam within the Shia tradition.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3184 - Al-Bazanti narrated from Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (as) who said:
"No one among my followers visits me, recognizing my right, except that I will intercede for them on the Day of Judgment."
